manifest.physical_independence: Unverified where physical_plate_id and group_id are null; registration text is metadata and is not used to infer plate identity.

budget_policy.status: experimental choices; not established optimal values

representation_rules.r0_cls: Whole-plate CLS from the shared whole forward output.
representation_rules.r1_mean_patch: Uniform mean of spatial patch tokens intersecting unpadded resized content; padding-only excluded; partial included; then L2-normalized.

r2_global_regional.concatenation_equivalence: Concatenate each normalized 384-D component scaled by sqrt(0.25)=0.5; the resulting 1536-D vector has unit norm and its cosine equals the weighted score.

representation_rules.r3_marker_cls: CLS of exact supplied marker xyxy crop; 9 eligible images only.

marker_visual_review.4: Supplied in-bounds marker crop; no coordinates were adjusted. Review the saved crop gallery before interpretation.

region_rounding: Original-crop lower x bounds use floor; upper x bounds use ceil; all bounds clamped; full source height retained.

evaluation_policy.similarity: cosine; R2 is fixed weighted corresponding-component cosine
evaluation_policy.group_exclusion: exclude matching non-null physical_plate_id or group_id
evaluation_policy.tie_resolution: smallest numerical reference ID while tie_flag remains true

workload.timing_policy: two fixed warm-up forwards; wall-clock per view; CUDA synchronized when applicable; loading excluded

r0_prior_equivalence.reason: Historical P0 equivalence applies only to DINOv2 budget mode.
